purpose: functional verification of usage figures on KVM; durations are the check's own stopwatch and are not a timing claim

cases.name: run, pause, resume, delete: the time it ran, not the time it was paused
vCPU-seconds and GiB-seconds are its size times its running time
a sandbox still running is counted to the moment asked
a sandbox deleted while paused adds nothing after its pause
a window cuts what it covers, and groups add up to the total
the usage ledger is not in what an E2B client is given
what cannot be asked is refused

detail.a time that is not one: from: "yesterday": RFC 3339 or milliseconds since the epoch (premature end of input)
detail.a grouping that is not one: Failed to deserialize query string: by: unknown variant `colour`, expected one of `sandbox`, `team`, `template`, `owner`
